item.title: Netanyahu says he has directed IDF to increase control of Gaza to 70%
item.description: The expansion in control by Israel would contradict the terms of the ceasefire Israel and Hamas agreed to in October 2025.

item.title: Gaza City hospitals say several killed in strike, as Israel targets Hamas leaders
item.description: At least five children were reportedly killed in the strike, which appears to have targeted a Hamas commander.

item.title: Israel hits Lebanese capital in 'targeted strike'
item.description: Beirut had until now largely been spared even as both Israel and Hezbollah accused each other of breaking last month's ceasefire.

item.title: No deal announced after Trump meeting to make 'final determination' on Iran
item.description: The US president met his advisers, after officials confirmed the US and Iran had agreed a framework of a deal.

item.title: Exploding rocket casts doubts over Nasa's Moon plans
item.description: Explosion of Blue Origin rocket is a setback for the company and for Nasa's Moon plans.

item.title: 'Controversial' North Korean invasion setting for next Call of Duty game
item.description: Developer Infinity Ward said the game will be "grounded in the military authenticity" the series is known for.

item.title: ישראל העלתה לראשונה את הרשימה השחורה של האו"ם על אלימות מינית באזורי מלחמה
item.description: ישראל אומרת כי היא דוחה את הטענות בדו"ח חדש של משרד מזכ"ל האו"ם.
